name: Oc xao bo toi
summary: Ốc xào bơ tỏi is snails stir-fried with butter and garlic. The conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 list pairs the plate with bánh mì and does not give a further recipe.
origin: Hoi An. The same 7 June 2023 list also names ốc hấp sả gừng and ốc xào me as evening plates.
howToEat: Eat it in the evening. The list says this plate comes with bánh mì.
A method beyond the name was not printed.
where: Hoi An, in the evening. A street and the hour are Check on arrival.
